_comment: Hoenn & Seek 2.1 (parts 18-20): gym leaders take weekends off once you've beaten them (2.1-plan section 6).
Read by tools/hoenn/gen_hoenn_weekends.py (its header explains what it writes). Re-run tools/hoenn/regen_all.sh after editing.
slot: the leader's place in the flag block (3 flags each: gym, spot, dojo). Saved: never change or reuse one.
gym / trainer: the gym map and the leader's graphics_id there. story_flag: the flag the leader's object had before
2.1 (HnS's own story hide), or 0; the generated flag keeps hiding the leader whenever that one is set.
beaten: the flag set when you beat the leader in their gym (Clair: before the Dragon's Den gives the badge). guide: the gym guide's own script (null: the gym has no guide).
dojo: HnS's FLAG_HIDE_DOJO_* for the leader's Fighting Dojo rematch (Saffron), or null. The Dojo copy takes
the weekend off too, and the weekend spot offers the same rematch once that flag is clear.
cameo: HnS's flag for the leader's one-time cameo (where you meet them to open that rematch), or null. While
the cameo is out (flag clear), the leader keeps their usual days, so they're never in two places at once.
leader_script: only where gym trainers share the leader's graphics (Fuchsia): the gym object's script.
rematch: {if_set, script}: the spot jumps to the leader's own rematch once that flag is set (Hoenn: after WALLACE).
partner: {trainer, at}: a second trainer object that moves with the leader, at the spot + at (Tate & Liza).
chain: (2.1-21) a fan chain's script the spot calls first (data/hoenn/fan_chains.json); it returns VAR_RESULT TRUE when it said its own line.
spot: where the leader spends Saturdays and Sundays: map, x, y, facing, elevation. The leader's follower there
comes from data/hoenn/trainer_followers.json (the trainer graphics_id is unique on the spot map).
line: what the leader says at the spot (before the rematch question). guide_line: the gym guide on a weekend.

line: Oh, {PLAYER}! Weekends are my day off from the GYM.
I come down to the beach to watch the sea birds ride the wind off the bay. My father used to bring me here.
You can learn a lot about flying just by watching.
guide_line: FALKNER's out today! On weekends he goes down to the beach at CHERRYGROVE CITY to watch the birds.
He's back on MONDAY, same as always.

line: Hi, {PLAYER}! Shh… There's a SCYTHER molting in that grass!
I spend my weekends in the NATIONAL PARK. The bugs here are different on a quiet day.
I've filled three notebooks already!
guide_line: BUGSY? On weekends he's at the NATIONAL PARK with his notebooks.
He'll be back on MONDAY, probably covered in leaves.

line: Oh! It's you! What're you doing at MOOMOO FARM?
Me? I help out here every weekend! MILTANK just loves the farm, and the milk is SO good.
Don't tell anyone, but I used to cry when I lost. Now I just come here and feel better!
guide_line: WHITNEY's at MOOMOO FARM on ROUTE 39 this weekend. She helps out with the MILTANK.
Come back on MONDAY if you want her here.

line: {PLAYER}… You found me.
I watch the KIMONO GIRLS dance on weekends. Their steps tell old stories, if you know how to see them.
Some of those stories are about the bird of rainbow colors. I'm still learning to read them.
guide_line: MORTY's not here. On weekends he watches the KIMONO GIRLS at the DANCE THEATER.
He says he's studying. He's back on MONDAY.

line: WAHAHAH! {PLAYER}! You came all the way into MT. MORTAR?
Every weekend I train by these waterfalls! My wife says I need a day off. THIS is my day off!
KIYO the KARATE KING trains deeper in. One day I'll beat him!
Oh… {PLAYER}. Hello.
I like the beach on weekends. STEELIX likes the warm sand, and I can still see AMPHY's light from here.
Everyone thinks steel is cold. But it's warm here in the sun.
guide_line: JASMINE spends her weekends on the beach on ROUTE 40, just west of town.
She'll be back on MONDAY. Quiet as ever.

line: Ah, the young one who melted my ice.
I sit by this pond on weekends. In winter it freezes over, and my old friend and I would skate on it.
At my age, a quiet pond is better company than most.
guide_line: PRYCE is out by the pond on ROUTE 44 this weekend. He's been going there for fifty years.
He'll be back on MONDAY.

line: Hmph. {PLAYER}. Don't think I'm resting.
LANCE once found a red GYARADOS in this lake. I come here on weekends to see what else it hides.
A dragon tamer never stops looking for dragons.
guide_line: CLAIR's at the LAKE OF RAGE this weekend. She's hunting for dragons. Of course she is.
She'll be back on MONDAY, ready to battle.

line: Hey, {PLAYER}! Weekends are when I help out here at the MUSEUM.
These fossils are millions of years old, and the team here still finds new ones.
Rocks remember everything. You just have to know how to listen to them.
guide_line: BROCK? He spends his weekends at the PEWTER MUSEUM, staring at fossils.
He'll be back on MONDAY, solid as a rock.

line: Oh, it's you! Don't stare, I'm on my day off!
Every weekend I swim out to the SEAFOAM ISLANDS. It's the best training there is.
A GYM pool is nice, but nothing beats the real ocean!
guide_line: MISTY's gone swimming! On weekends she swims out to the SEAFOAM ISLANDS on ROUTE 20.
She'll be back on MONDAY. Probably sunburned.

line: Hey, kid! At ease! It's the weekend!
I come down to the docks to watch the big ships come in. Reminds me of my navy days.
One of these days I'll ship out again. Just not this weekend!
guide_line: LT. SURGE is down at the VERMILION docks this weekend, watching the ships.
He's back on MONDAY, loud as ever.

line: Oh, hello… I'm sorry, I was nearly asleep.
On weekends I visit PALLET TOWN. The flowers here grow so freely, with no one to tend them.
It's very calming. I may take a little nap.
Fufufu! You spotted me! My disguise needs work.
I practice my ninja arts out here on weekends. Hiding in the trees, moving without a sound…
Father trained me the same way. Don't tell him you found me!
guide_line: The real JANINE's not here. On weekends she trains on ROUTE 15, east of town.
She'll be back on MONDAY. Or maybe she's here already, in disguise!

line: …I knew you would come here today, {PLAYER}.
On weekends I sit with MR. FUJI's spirits. The POKéMON who rest here have a lot to say.
Their voices are quiet. Most people never stop to hear them.
guide_line: SABRINA's not here. She told me you'd ask. On weekends she goes to the SOUL HOUSE in LAVENDER TOWN.
She'll be back on MONDAY. She knew that before I did.

line: Hah! {PLAYER}! Here's a quiz: where does a fire GYM LEADER go on a weekend off?
Answer: right back home to CINNABAR! The volcano took my GYM, but not my island.
I sit here, drink my coffee, and think up new riddles!
guide_line: BLAINE goes home to CINNABAR ISLAND on weekends. He sits in the POKéMON CENTER there.
He'll be back on MONDAY with a new riddle.

line: Hey! What, you think a GYM LEADER can't take a weekend?
I come out to ROUTE 22 to train. This is the road to the POKéMON LEAGUE. I walked it as CHAMPION once.
Someday I'll walk it again. Smell ya later!
guide_line: BLUE takes weekends off. He trains on ROUTE 22, west of town, on the way to the LEAGUE.
He'll be back on MONDAY. Bragging, probably.

line: Oh! Hello, {PLAYER}. I'm on a field trip of my own today.
On weekends I visit the FOSSIL MANIAC here on ROUTE 114. He has dug up more than any textbook shows!
A GYM LEADER should never stop being a student.
guide_line: ROXANNE spends her weekends on ROUTE 114, talking fossils with the FOSSIL MANIAC.
She'll be back on MONDAY with new notes.

line: Yo, {PLAYER}! Check out these waves!
DEWFORD's swell is small on weekends, so I come over to SLATEPORT's beach to ride the big ones.
Getting knocked down and paddling back out. That's how you get tough!
guide_line: BRAWLY? He's riding the waves at SLATEPORT's beach on ROUTE 109 this weekend.
He'll be back on MONDAY. Probably still dripping.

line: Wahahahah! Well, if it isn't {PLAYER}!
Every weekend I come out here to watch the young ones on the CYCLING ROAD. All that pedaling could power a city!
Don't tell anyone, but I've been sketching a bike that charges a battery.
guide_line: WATTSON's out on ROUTE 110 by the CYCLING ROAD. He goes every weekend to watch the bikes.
He'll be back on MONDAY, laughing as loud as ever.

line: {PLAYER}! You came all the way up MT. CHIMNEY? Wow!
My grandfather used to bring me up here on weekends. I still come to feel the heat.
Being near the crater reminds me why I love fire. And why I have to keep it under control!
guide_line: FLANNERY goes up MT. CHIMNEY every weekend. She says it's where her grandpa trained.
She'll be back on MONDAY, all fired up.

line: Ah, {PLAYER}. Caught me on my day off.
On weekends I come out to fish on ROUTE 104. MAY always guesses that's where I'll be.
A fishing line teaches patience. So does raising POKéMON.
guide_line: NORMAN goes fishing on ROUTE 104 every weekend. He says it clears his head.
He's back on MONDAY, ready for challengers.

line: Hello, {PLAYER}. Look up. Do you see them?
On weekends I come to ROUTE 120 to watch the wild bird POKéMON ride the storm winds.
Every flight is different. That's what makes the sky beautiful.
guide_line: WINONA spends her weekends on ROUTE 120, watching the birds in the wind.
She'll be back on MONDAY.

line: TATE: Hehehe… We knew you'd come here, {PLAYER}!
LIZA: Fufufu… On weekends we help at the SPACE CENTER. We count the rockets together.
TATE: The scientists say we're the only helpers who never disagree!
guide_line: TATE and LIZA are at the SPACE CENTER this weekend. They help count the launches.
They'll be back on MONDAY. Both of them, at the same time.

line: Ah, {PLAYER}. What a pleasant surprise.
On weekends I come to LILYCOVE to watch the CONTESTS. Beauty in battle is an art I still study.
My student WALLACE taught me a few things here, too. Don't tell him I said so.
guide_line: JUAN is at the CONTEST HALL in LILYCOVE CITY this weekend. He never misses a show.
He'll be back on MONDAY.
